title: UP DELED 2022, 2024 Semester Exam Result 2026
postName: UP BTC / D.El.Ed. Semester Examination Result – Batches 2022 & 2024
vacancyDetails: Semester exam marksheets for D.El.Ed. (BTC) 2022 and 2024 batch candidates (1st / 2nd / 3rd / 4th semester as applicable)
qualification: Enrolled UP D.El.Ed. (BTC) trainee of 2022 or 2024 batch as per PNP records
applicationFee: As per semester exam form fee of Examination Regulatory Authority
selectionProcess: Semester Theory & Practical Examination → Result / Marksheet → Scrutiny where applicable
documentsRequired: Roll Number and Date of Birth for online marksheet login
howToApply:
1. Visit https://updeledinfo.in or https://btcexam.in / https://updeled.gov.in
2. Open D.El.Ed. Exam Result / Marksheet link for your batch & semester
3. Enter Roll Number and Date of Birth
4. View and download semester marksheet
5. Keep a printout for college records and further formalities
shortDescription: UP BTC D.El.Ed. semester exam results 2026 for 2022 and 2024 batches. Check 1st–4th semester marksheets at updeledinfo.in / btcexam.in with Roll No. and DOB.
content:
The Examination Regulatory Authority, Uttar Pradesh (Prayagraj) has released / updated UP D.El.Ed. (BTC) Semester Exam Results 2026 for candidates of the 2022 and 2024 batches.

Results cover relevant semesters (including 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th as scheduled). Candidates can check marksheets using Roll Number and Date of Birth on official portals.

Useful portals

  • updeledinfo.in – Exam & scrutiny results by batch/semester
  • btcexam.in – Ankchit / marksheet downloads
  • updeled.gov.in – Official DELED information

Always verify your name, roll number, marks and pass status carefully. For any discrepancy, follow the official recheck / scrutiny process notified by the authority.
